review_basis: Snapshot uses trusted no-replacement Git reads of exact candidate tree/blobs, checks paths/modes/blob IDs/contained links and bounds files/bytes/time. Peer mounts expose no owned writable path, host Board database, host Git metadata, credentials or network.

Per-attempt ContextVar and immutable configuration prevent concurrent jobs replacing a shared runner/config; scheduler claims only available capacity, bounds total admissions and keeps result order tied to claim order.

Single host-owned trace store validates complete bounded three-peer responses before an append, retains dissent/superseded history and returns detached data. Parent API remains embargoed until closure. Protocol completion is advisory and never invokes Board acceptance or merge.

Normal cancellation settles peer/author process groups and actual Board operations before releasing the Mesh admission lock. In-flight atomic submit can finish VERIFYING; cancellation is not rollback. Existing separately grouped process handling remains under the reviewed runtime boundary.

Node edge uses fixed trusted script location, structured argv, bounded output/batch deadline, explicit offline authorization and response correlation. CLI config alone cannot enable offline execution.
One Board remains the ownership domain and integration remains separately supervised/serialized. Dispatcher never runs verify, review, merge or application controller.

test_author_separation.note: The native two-test oracle was authored separately in /tmp at supervisor request. Its successful runs/mutation checks are evidence, not this reviewer approving their own trust-policy contribution.

limits: Offline local operators/fixtures only. No paid providers, authenticated remote Mesh broker, quota reservation, or cross-vendor model-quality/throughput claim.

flock excludes participating Mesh supervisors in a Git common directory, not legacy dispatchers/arbitrary Git processes. One Board ownership domain and one supervised target integration queue remain required.
Worker-group concurrency limits are not CPU/RAM/PID/disk quotas.

Trace store trusts its host-owned file path and operator. Inode/size checks do not detect every same-inode same-length external rewrite; there is no external append-integrity anchor or crash reopen/recovery protocol.
Parent embargo and acknowledged input watermarks are host API protocol rules, not proof that an analyst reasoned about every supplied trace.

The Node60-second grace is a forced-transport-failure bound, not proof all arbitrarily stalled storage finishes within60seconds. Hard kill/crash requires actual Board/lease inspection and must not be treated as completion.

Completed peer rounds do not certify code correctness and do not authorize MERGED. Data-fixture Board gates and the separately trusted full application controller retain their own authority. General D09/W14 application adapter remains absent.

This approval covers four identified runtime files. Supervisor must bind final candidate/trusted policy bytes and complete all required acceptance groups before integration; separate reviewers own new oracle/policy trust adoption.
